"""Independent E2E verification using real processor grids and scalar geometry."""
import ast,json,math,sys
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
from qwen_vl_utils.vision_process import fetch_image
from transformers.models.qwen2_vl.image_processing_qwen2_vl import Qwen2VLImageProcessor

r=Path(sys.argv[1]);result=json.loads(next((r/'results').rglob('*_results.json')).read_text());assert '(chat)' in result['config']['model_backend']
settings=result['configs']['share_robot_affordance']['generation_kwargs'];assert settings['share_robot_coordinate_profile']=='qwen2_5_vl_chat'
processor=Qwen2VLImageProcessor(size={'shortest_edge':settings['share_robot_min_pixels'],'longest_edge':settings['share_robot_max_pixels']})
base=Path('/mnt/umm/shared_model/huggingface/hub/datasets--BAAI--ShareRobot-Bench/snapshots/68e9c15600f85f601b9cf492e4d994b50ed4cd4d/affordance')
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in next((r/'results').rglob('*_samples_share_robot_affordance.jsonl')).read_text().splitlines()];checked=[]
for row in rows:
 raw=ast.literal_eval(row['filtered_resps']);gt=ast.literal_eval(row['target'])
 with Image.open(base/row['input_media'][0]) as im:
  w,h=im.size;processed=processor(images=[fetch_image({'image':im.convert('RGB')})],return_tensors='pt')
 _,gh,gw=processed['image_grid_thw'][0].tolist();rw,rh=gw*processor.patch_size,gh*processor.patch_size
 box=[raw[0]*w/rw,raw[1]*h/rh,raw[2]*w/rw,raw[3]*h/rh]
 i=max(0,min(box[2],gt[2])-max(box[0],gt[0]))*max(0,min(box[3],gt[3])-max(box[1],gt[1]));u=(box[2]-box[0])*(box[3]-box[1])+(gt[2]-gt[0])*(gt[3]-gt[1])-i;c=(max(box[2],gt[2])-min(box[0],gt[0]))*(max(box[3],gt[3])-min(box[1],gt[1]));iou=i/u;giou=iou-(c-u)/c
 assert math.isclose(iou,row['mean_iou'],abs_tol=1e-12),(row['doc_id'],iou,row['mean_iou'])
 checked.append({'doc_id':row['doc_id'],'raw_prediction':raw,'original_size':[w,h],'processor_size':[rw,rh],'converted_prediction':box,'target':gt,'intersection':i,'union':u,'iou':iou,'generalized_iou':giou})
scores={'mean_iou':sum(x['iou'] for x in checked)/len(checked),'mean_generalized_iou':sum(x['generalized_iou'] for x in checked)/len(checked),'cumulative_iou':sum(x['intersection'] for x in checked)/sum(x['union'] for x in checked),'precision_at_0_5':sum(x['iou']>=.5 for x in checked)/len(checked)}
for name,value in scores.items():assert math.isclose(value,result['results']['share_robot_affordance'][name+',none'],abs_tol=1e-12),name
assert any(x['converted_prediction']!=x['raw_prediction'] for x in checked)
report={'passed':True,'backend':result['config']['model_backend'],'metrics':scores,'samples':checked};(r/'independent-coordinate-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({'passed':True,'metrics':scores},indent=2))
